Hi Alex — thanks for the sample, this is exactly the kind of telemetry we need. Quick intake questions so we can produce a realistic Dedicated footprint (we've kept them brief — answers in-line or as a CSV are fine):

1) Session semantics: do sessions persist KV cache across requests and for how long (idle timeout)? Typical values: 1m / 5m / 30m / session-per-request
2) Burst shape: is the 12k concurrency a single-sweep spike or composed of many small bursts across endpoints? If the latter, what's the percent within the 45-minute window that sits above 8k concurrency?
3) SLA banding: for the baseline plan do you need 95th-percentile latency SLO of <200ms for short-chat paths, or is 500ms acceptable?
4) Model fallbacks: do you want automatic fallback to quantized variants when capacity constrained? If yes, list acceptable model families for fallback.
5) Data residency & retention: any constraints that require routing to a specific region or limits on log retention?
6) Batch job cadence: how many parallel batch jobs during peak (100s/1k/5k) and are batch jobs pre-scheduled or ad-hoc?
7) Growth horizon: expected concurrency growth in 6/12/24 months (percentiles are fine).

Attachments we will produce back to you: a first-cut GPU mix + occupancy model (xlsx), and a short assumptions doc.

If you prefer, we can run a short sync with Marissa (solutions) and Ben (capacity planning) next week to walk through the sample and show the sizing model live. Do any of these timeslots work: Tue 9/19 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 9/20 14:00–15:00 PT?

Thanks — will aim to turn around a draft footprint within 3 business days after your answers.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Tessa — quick answers below, hope this helps:

1) KV cache: multi-turn sessions keep a small KV cache. Idle timeout is config-driven but typical is 10 minutes for webchat and 30 minutes for in-app assistants.
2) Burst shape: launch day was a single concentrated sweep from a marketing campaign; ~65% of the 45-minute window was above 8k concurrency, with a 7-minute crest where concurrency peaked. Normal day-to-day has many microbursts (50–200 concurrency) rather than sustained peaks.
3) SLA banding: baseline needs 95th < 300ms for short-chat (we can tolerate 300–500ms for long generation paths).
4) Fallbacks: yes — acceptable fallbacks are: quantized-llama-13b, q-llama-30b (if latency bump is tolerable). Fine-tuned gpt-style model must be pinned to Dedicated or we risk quality regressions.
5) Data residency: must keep EU-origin traffic within eu-west-1 region; US traffic ok in us-west-2. Logs can be retained for 90 days.
6) Batch cadence: parallel batch workers: typically 120 concurrent workers during daily report windows; large monthly batch jobs spike up to ~1.1k parallel tasks but run in overnight windows.
7) Growth horizon: expecting +45% concurrency in 6 months, +110% in 12 months, +220% in 24 months (rough).

I've attached a tiny sample of per-request timing and a short README inside request_logs.tar.gz. If you need a CSV that maps session IDs to model choice, say the word and we'll extract it.

If the Tue/Wed timeslots work for you, Wed 9/20 14:00 PT is best for me.

Thanks,
Alex

-- Notes / initial assumptions (Tessa):
- Baseline steady concurrency estimate: 1.3M sessions/month translates to ~820 average concurrent sessions across US+EU (back-of-envelope, will refine in spreadsheet).
- Peak provisioning target: support 12k observed peak with 1.5x headroom for the crest -> target headroom around 18k concurrent sessions for the 7-minute crest. We'll propose an autoscale corridor and a reserved burst pool.
- KV cache: assume 10m idle for webchat, 30m for assistants (adds memory pressure — factor into occupancy).
- Model mix: reserve capacity for fine-tuned gpt-style instances in reserved pool (no quantization fallback for those), allow fallback for open-llama family to quantized variants during burst.
- Region routing: need dedicated reservations in eu-west-1 and us-west-2; propose split based on traffic origin (we'll derive exact split from CSV).
- Batch window: design bulk job carve-out to avoid starving interactive queues (we recommend pre-provisioned batch pool sized for 1.1k parallel tasks overnight).

Ben / Marissa — can you review the attached workbook and confirm:
1) suggested GPU SKUs and counts (we have a preliminary mix: 8x A10G-equivalents for interactive, 4x A100-q8 for fine-tuned models, 6x T4-like for batch; numbers are placeholders in spreadsheet)
2) occupancy model parameters for KV cache assumptions and session idle retention
3) recommended autoscale policy (target utilization, cooldown, burst pool rules)

I scheduled a joint call with Alex Wed 9/20 14:00 PT (same time as this email). If we can turn the attached into a one-slide risk/ask doc before the call that would be ideal.

Thanks — Tessa
